svg.title: Encoding an object identifier
svg.desc: The OID 1.3.101.112 (Ed25519) becomes 2B 65 70: the first two arcs fold into 40*1+3 = 43 = 0x2B, the rest are base-128 digits. The arc 840 needs two digits, 6 and 72, written 86 48 with the top bit marking "more follows".

text.tspan: big arcs: base 128, top bit = "more digits follow"
